free_tier.stated: Zero free bytes by design. ClearML's free tier is 'Flexible Storage — Store your datasets on any storage service and connect to ClearML – HTTP/S3/GCS/Azure/NAS'. That is bring-your-own-bucket: ClearML supplies the versioning layer, you supply (and pay for) the bytes. Differential storage reduces what you must store, but it does not create storage.

egress.terms: Yours, because the bytes are on your storage. ClearML itself charges nothing for egress since it never holds the data.

tooling: clearml Python SDK + clearml-agent; `Dataset.create()` / `dataset.add_files()` / `dataset.upload()` against any S3/GCS/Azure/HTTP/NAS backend. Mature and well documented.
chaining: There is nothing to multiply — the storage is a user's own account at AWS/GCS/Azure, all of which are excluded on cost grounds.
limits_note: Differential/dedup versioning means versions store only the change set from the parent, which is a genuine byte-saver. Free plan feature-limited (SSO and configuration vault are paid/enterprise). No included storage at all.
reliability_note: Reliable; the server is open source and self-hostable. But as a free-storage route it is a null result: it is a control plane, not a data plane.
confidence_note: One page read moves it to documented.
